reader.requirement: At --std 85, when a control heading, control footing or detail group is to be presented and does not fit on the page, the page advance (page footing, new page, page heading) is processed after the group is determined to be presented (its USE procedure has run) and before its lines are printed.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues: at 85 the PF/PH of a footing-phase page advance see the current control values
DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup: at 85 a saved NEXT GROUP still forces the TERMINATE footings' page advance through PlaceAfterSavedNextGroup

reader.edition-search: grep IsActive/Edition in ReportWriter.cs; PresentBody's fit test and AdvancePage's order consult nothing
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: the control values the interrupting PF/PH see during a footing phase (current at 85, prior at 2002+), and the TERMINATE treatment of a saved NEXT GROUP; the interrupt itself is the same code
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f29_06 covers a detail-caused page advance; control-heading and control-footing caused advances are not exercised there

probes.printed: page 1 CF A at 8 then PF 1, PH 2 before CH B (CH-caused); page 2 DE B 05-09 then PF 2, PH 3 before DE B 10 (detail-caused); CF C at 9 then PF 3, PH 4 before CFF/TOT (footing-caused at TERMINATE); PF 4, RF C
probes.expected: each body group that fails its fit is preceded by PF, page advance and PH (PAGE LIMIT 12, FIRST DETAIL 3, LAST DETAIL 8, FOOTING 10)

probes.printed: at --std 85 the PH USE during the TERMINATE footing's page advance sees KEY Z (current); at --std 2023 it sees C (prior)
probes.expected: 85: §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR13c, the PH is not a control footing, current values

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR12  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12

reader.notes: PresentBody calls BeginGroup (USE procedure, SUPPRESS) before its fit test, and AdvancePage does PF, PageFeed, PH, in that order, before PresentLines. The probe shows the interrupt for all three body group kinds. The report file was identical at --std 2023.

refuter.evidence: Aimed at what the reader did not try: a body group that would not fit but is SUPPRESSed, and the order of its USE procedure against the page advance, read through PAGE-COUNTER and LINE-COUNTER. PAGE LIMIT 12 HEADING 1 FIRST DETAIL 3 LAST DETAIL 8 FOOTING 10, PH LINE 1, PF LINE 11, DA LINE PLUS 1, CF WS-KEY of two lines, USE BEFORE REPORTING DA and CFK. r8supp-001 at --std 85: DA 07 would land on line 9 (past LAST DETAIL), its USE saw PC 01 LC 08 and SUPPRESSed: no page advance, the CF then fitted at lines 9-10 of page 1, and only DA 08 (USE saw PC 01 LC 10, i.e. before the advance) caused PF 01, PH 02 and DA 08 at line 3; DA 13 likewise (USE PC 02 LC 09, then PF 02, PH 03, DA 13 at line 3). r7supp-001: DA 07 overflow with its USE at PC 01 LC 08 before PF 01 / PH 02, and the suppressed DA 08 consumed no line. The page group is processed after the USE procedure decides the group is presented and before its lines, as GR12 says. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR12  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR12'. Not probed by me: a control-footing-caused advance at a GENERATE break (the reader's p7pagb covers the footing-caused one at TERMINATE; the fit test is the same PresentBody).
